why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: Use only voltrade.xyz and connect a wallet. "Voltrade registration should remain wallet-first", so email is optional.
Connect X for the 1,000 VXP bonus if you are happy to link that account.

Wait for a competition, then read its page first: prize pool, dates, eligible markets, daily cap, minimum volume, payout method and any country limits. Each one can set its own "geographic restrictions".
Register before you trade. "Registering costs nothing but a signature", and on some venues earlier volume doesn't count.

Trade on the partner venue itself. Stop at any daily cap, because Voltrade says that beyond it "every additional dollar you trade that day is pure cost". Warning Competitions reward volume, which pushes people to overtrade. Leverage, fees and market moves can cost far more than a prize pays.

After the end, check how your prize is paid. "A Merkl-distributed reward sitting unclaimed is still yours, but it does not arrive on its own." Other prizes are sent by Voltrade or the partner, with no fixed date.
